messages.content:
[1] suggested form אב
Uses:
  1a) אבא = "my father" [Hebrew] — in: שלא יאמר אדם לחבירו [אבא] גדול מאביך ושלא יהו
  1b) מאביך = "than your father" [Hebrew] — in: אדם לחבירו אבא גדול [מאביך] ושלא יהו המינים אומרים
  1c) אב = "primary source" [Hebrew] — in: חוץ מן המשקה שהוא [אב] הטומאה
  1d) לאבוה = "his father" [Aramaic] — in: לא חציף איניש לשוויי [לאבוה] שליח ודילמא ארצויי ארצייה
  1e) האב = "the father" [Hebrew] — in: דאמר חוששין שמא נתרצה [האב] הני מילי דרך כבוד
  1f) אביה = "her father" [Hebrew] — in: נתקדשה לדעת [אביה] והלך אביה למדינת הים
  1g) ואביה = "and her father" [Hebrew] — in: לדעת וניסת שלא לדעת [ואביה] כאן רב הונא אמר
  1h) לאב = "the father" [Aramaic] — in: התם הוא דלא איתיה [לאב] אבל הכא דאיתיה לאב
Candidates:
  1. אַבָּא I (from the word) — (no English given)
  2. אַבָּא II (from the word) — בָּא, וָוא, וָוה in Y.) pr. n. m. Abba, (Ba, Va), a frequent name. [Sometimes distinguished persons go by that; א׳ אריכא, v. רַב; רב א׳ v. רָבָא; בר בא) א׳ בר אבהו Abba bar Abbahu (Ba), father of Samuel, an Amora. Abba bar Abbahu (Ba), father of Samuel, an; א׳ בר רב הונא, in Bab. רַבָּה q. v; א׳ מרי, contr. אבמרי Abba 
  3. אַבָּא III (from the word) — Abba (father), a title of scholars (less than Rabbi), as Abba Saul, A. Yudan, etc.; cmp. foreg
  4. אִבָּא (from the word) — אבב); thicket, woods, grove; fruit, v. אִיבָּא
  5. אִיבָּא I (from the word) — cmp. אֵב) growth, fruit
  6. Klein: אַבָּא (from the word) — father, daddy; ‘Abba’ — title of ancient Rabbis; reverend (father)
  7. אִנְבָּא I (via אִיבָּא I) — = אִיבָּא I, fruit, produce
  8. אִנְבָּא II (via אִיבָּא I) — אִינְבָּא f. (= עִינְבָּא) [berries], eggs of lice, nits. Naz
  9. אַב־ — a prefix of words of Greek origin answering to αὐ-, au-, e.g. אבטומטוס = αὐτόματος; or to εὐ, e.g. אבגינוס = ε
  10. אָב I — Assyr. A-bu, Schr. K. A. T., p
  11. אָב II — const. אֲבִי, אַב [embracer], father, ancestor, progenitor; teacher; chief, leader; author, originator; fathers, ancestors, patriarchs &c; Aboth, the first section of the Prayer of Benedictions (v. תְּפִלָּה), so called because it alludes to the Pat; Aboth, name of a treatise of the Mishnah, containing sayings of Talmu
  12. אָב II ² — ch., v. אַבָּא
  13. אֵב — swelling, spreading, whence; the young shoots of a tree, opp. to the branches growing directly from the trunk; pl. אִבִּין, אִיבִּין state of growth, development
  14. Klein: אָב ᴵ — father; forefather, patriarch; ancestor, progenitor; head (of a family), leader, chief; God; master, teacher; important, great; parent (male); basic factor, origin, source; Father (of the Christian Church)
  15. Klein: אָב ᴵᴵ — ‘Av’ (also ‘Ab’) — name of the fifth month of the Jewish calendar
  16. אביך (from the word) — (no English given)
  17. אָבַךְ (from the word) — to entangle. Hithp. הִתְאַבֵּךְ to blend (of whirling smoke columns)
  18. Klein: אָבִיךְ (from the word) — hazy, misty
  19. Klein: אבך (from the word) — to rise (smoke), to raise clouds of dust; — Qal prob. meaning ‘it rose’ (said esp. of smoke); — Pi. it rolled up, billowed (said esp. of smoke); — Pu. was rolled up, was billowed (said esp. of smoke); — Pu. was perplexed, was confused; — Hith. was rolled up, was billowed (a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring; — Hi
  20. Klein: אֹֽבֶךְ (from the word) — mist, haze, haziness
  21. Klein: אֵב (from the word) — young shoot, sprout, verdure
  22. אַבָּה (from the word) — Abbah; father of Samuel; v. אַבָּא II
  23. אָבָה (from the word) — v. אבי
  24. אָבֵי (via אָבָה) — to be willing

[2] suggested form אבן
Uses:
  2a) האבנים = "the stones" [Hebrew] — in: מושלך על העצים ועל [האבנים]
  2b) באבנים = "with stones" [Hebrew] — in: רבנן וכסהו יכול יכסנו [באבנים] או יכפה עליו את
  2c) אבנים = "stones" [Hebrew] — in: הדק וחול הדק ושחיקת [אבנים] ושחיקת חרסית ונעורת פשתן
Candidates:
  1. Klein: אָבְנַֽיִם (from the word) — dual; potter’s wheel; mid-wife’s stool; workbench
  2. אֶבֶן — v. Ges. H. Dict. s. v.) stone; Compounds and combinations: . Stone Chamber, name of a Temple compartment. Parah III
  3. אֶבֶן ² — (Aramaic, ch.) same as the entry above: v. Ges. H. Dict. s. v.) stone; Compounds and combinations: . Stone Chamber, name of a Temple compartment. Parah III
  4. אֹבֶן — only in Du. אָבְנַיִם (b. h; the potter’s turning implement; the passage of the embryo, vagina
  5. Klein: אֶֽבֶן — stone; weight
  6. Klein: אבן — to petrify, to change into stone; — Pi. it changed into stone, petrified; — Pi. he fossilized; — Pu. was changed into stone, was petrified; — Hith. became petrified; — Hith. became fossilized; — Hith. was paralyzed

[3] suggested form אגן
Uses:
  3a) אגן = "goblet" [Hebrew] — in: חנינא דאמר קרא שררך [אגן] הסהר אל יחסר המזג
Candidates:
  1. Klein: אַגָּן (from the word) — (no English given)
  2. Klein: אֹֽגֶן (from the word) — rim of a vessel; brim of a hat

[4] suggested form אגף
Uses:
  4a) אגפיים = "the sides" [Hebrew] — in: אמרו דם הניתז ושעל [אגפיים] חייב לכסות אמר רבן
Candidates:
  1. אָגַף — sec. r. of גְּפַף, v. גּוּף) to fill up a hole with pitch &c
  2. גּוּף I (via אָגַף) — perf. a. part. גָּף (= גָּפַף) [to join body to body,] to squeeze, cork, bung; Pi. to embrace, hug
  3. גּוּף (via אָגַף) — to close; to embrace,] to have illegitimate intercourse, to commit adultery with; Af. אָגֵף to close; Pa. as Pe
  4. גּוּף II (via אָגַף) — body, person, self; essence, substance; membrum; surface, color (cmp. גַּוָּון)
  5. אַגָּף — גּוּף I) the moulding or eminence of the door frame against which the door shuts, door-stop (esp. of door-ways
  6. אֲגַף — com. (v. foreg. = גַּף; cmp. b. h. אֲגַפִּים); wing, pinion. Pl. אֲגַפִּים; Du. אֲגַפַּיִים; winged animals, poultry; arms, shoulders of a human being; banks of river &c
  7. Klein: אֲגַף — wing of a bird; wing of a building; the upper part of the arm; flank of an army
  8. Klein: אגף — to flank, to outflank; — Qal he flanked, outflanked; — Pi. of s.m.); — Pu. was flanked, was outflanked

[5] suggested form אדם
Uses:
  5a) אדם = "man" [Hebrew] — in: דתניא הכוהו עשרה בני [אדם] בעשר מקלות בין בבת
  5b) אדם = "a person" [Hebrew] — in: עד מפי עד ומפי [אדם] נאמן שמא אי אתם
  5c) אדם = "Adam" [Hebrew] — in: לפיכך נברא [אדם] יחידי ללמדך שכל המאבד
  5d) שאדם = "that a person" [Hebrew] — in: של הקדוש ברוך הוא [שאדם] טובע כמה מטבעות בחותם
  5e) אדם = "person" [Hebrew] — in: ברוך הוא טבע כל [אדם] בחותמו של אדם הראשון
  5f) אדם = "people" [Hebrew] — in: שאין דרכן של בני [אדם] להתבונן בדרכים
Candidates:
  1. אֲדַם (from the word) — v. הֲדַם. [v. Rabb. D. S. to
  2. אָדַם (from the word) — v. דמם) [to be viscous, thick, dark] to be red, grow red; Pi. to redden, make red; Hif. b. h.) (b. h.) to be, grow red; Hif. to cause to blush, put to shame (usu. הלבין)
  3. אָדָם (from the word) — m. (b. h.) man, pr. n. m. Adam, frequ. א׳ הראשון (abbr. אה"ר)
  4. אֲדָם (from the word) — = דָּם, דְּמָא) blood
  5. Klein: אָדָם (from the word) — with no. pl.); a man; colloq.) man, mankind; ‘Adam’, name of the first man (according to the Bible)
  6. Klein: אדם (from the word) — to be red; — Qal was red; — Pi. he reddened; — Pu. = was reddened); — Hith. became red, reddened; — Hiph. became red, reddened, blushed
  7. Klein: אָדֹם (from the word) — red
  8. הֲדַם (via אֲדַם) — Pa. (אַדֵּם) הַדֵּם; to dissect, dismember, tear to pieces; אֲהַדֵּם (denom. of next w.) to arrange the parts of an animal
  9. הַדָּם (via אֲדַם) — v. preced.) part, member.—Pl. הַדָּמִין, הַדָּמֵי
  10. חוּל (via אֲדָם) — to turn around, circle; to dance. Part. חָל, חוֹל; perf. חָל; cmp. חַג) to come in turn, to occur; with על) to hover around one’s head, to rest upon one as a duty; to take effect (as a law); Hof. to be made to circle,] to be commenced, established
  11. חוּל ² (via אֲדָם) — to dance. Part. חָיֵיל; to take effect. Yoma; to hover over one’s head, be impending; Ithpa. to turn in a circle, dance
  12. חוּל II (via אֲדָם) — v. חָלָה) to be smooth, quiet, v. infra; Hithpol. to be quieted
  13. חוּל ³ (via אֲדָם) — to be smooth, lax; to be forgiving, renounce; to be sweet; Pa. to sweeten (by adding good wine), to improve; Af. אַחֲלֵי, fr. חלי) to be liberal, to forgive
  14. חוֹל I (via אֲדָם) — sand, sand-region, esp. the sand used for glass-making
  15. חוֹל II (via אֲדָם) — Ḥol, name of a fabulous bird (Phoenix)

[6] suggested form אומד
Uses:
  6a) מאומד = "from conjecture" [Hebrew] — in: ומאיימין עליהן שמא תאמרו [מאומד] ומשמועה עד מפי עד
Candidates:
  1. אוּמָד (from the word) — אָמַד) estimate, guess, measuring by mere sight, approximate assessment; medical opinion as to the nature of i
  2. אָמַד (from the word) — √מד; v. מָדַד) to form an approximate estimate, to guess; to appraise, judge, deliver an expert’s opinion; Hif. same
  3. אֲמַד (from the word) — (Aramaic, ch.) same as the entry above: √מד; v. מָדַד) to form an approximate estimate, to guess; to appraise, judge, deliver an expert’s opinion; Hif. same
  4. Klein: אְֹמֶד (from the word) — estimation, estimate, assessment, appraisal, valuation, reckoning
  5. Klein: אמד ᴵ (from the word) — to estimate, calculate, reckon; — Qal he estimated, made a rough estimate, assessed, appraised, valued, reckoned, conjectured, guessed; — Niph. was estimated, was assessed, was appraised, was valued; — Hiph. he estimated, conjectured, guessed; — Hoph. was estimated
  6. Klein: אמד ᴵᴵ (from the word) — to make well-to-do; — Hith. he became well-to-do

[7] suggested form אות
Uses:
  7a) אות = "letter" [Hebrew] — in: משתייר נשתייר בו כשיעור [אות] קטנה כשר ואם לאו
  7b) לאותיות = "to the letters" [Hebrew] — in: הוא שיושב וקושר כתרים [לאותיות] אמר לפניו רבונו של
  7c) אותיות = "letters" [Hebrew] — in: אמר רבא שבעה [אותיות] צריכות שלשה זיונין ואלו
Candidates:
  1. אוֹת I (from the word) — to join, fit; Nif. b. h.) to be suited, pleased, whence to be gratified, to enjoy
  2. אוֹת II (from the word) — c. (b. h.; v. אוי; mark, sign, emblem; test, signal, military ensign. Ḥag; letter, writing, symbol
  3. אוֹת III (from the word) — v. אֵת) only with pronominal suffix; indicating the objective case, אוֹתִי me, אוֹתְךָ thee, &c; with pronom. suffix of third person, for emphasizing the subject, אוֹתוֹ he himself, this one, the same, he wh
  4. Klein: אוֹת ᴵ (from the word) — sign, signal, symbol, token; miracle
  5. Klein: אוֹת ᴵᴵ (from the word) — letter (of the alphabet)
  6. Klein: אות ᴵ (from the word) — to consent, agree; base of נֵאוֹת; — Niph. he consented, agreed

[8] suggested form אח
Uses:
  8a) אחיו = "his brother" [Hebrew] — in: מצינו בקין שהרג את [אחיו] שנאמר דמי אחיך צעקים
  8b) אחיך = "your brother" [Hebrew] — in: את אחיו שנאמר דמי [אחיך] צעקים אינו אומר דם
Candidates:
  1. Klein: אָֽחוּ (from the word) — reeds, Nile grass; meadow
  2. אָח I — brother, kinsman; fellow, equal, fellow-believer &c
  3. אַח — (Aramaic, ch.) same as the entry above: brother, kinsman; fellow, equal, fellow-believer &c
  4. אָח II — interj. interj; b. h.) exclamation of sorrow, Oh!
  5. Klein: אָח ᴵ — brother; kinsman; friend; friar
  6. Klein: אָח ᴵᴵ — fire port, brazier, fireplace
  7. אֲחִיךְ (from the word) — to laugh, v. חוּךְ
  8. חוֹךְ (via אֲחִיךְ) — to rub, scratch, v. חָכַךְ
  9. חוּךְ I (via אֲחִיךְ) — (Aramaic, ch.) same as the entry above: to rub, scratch, v. חָכַךְ
  10. חוּךְ II (via אֲחִיךְ) — onomatop., v. preced.) [to hawk,] to laugh, (= צָחַק) to jest with, caress; to laugh at. Part. חָאִיךְ, חָיֵיך; Pa. same; Pa. to hawk; Pa. to laugh; Af. same
  11. חוֹךְ I (via אֲחִיךְ) — scab, v. חִיכּוּךְ
  12. חוֹךְ II (via אֲחִיךְ) — חוּךְ II) laughter, gladness, object of derision
  13. Klein: אָח ᴵᴵᴵ — woe! alas!

[9] suggested form אחר
Uses:
  9a) אחר = "after" [Hebrew] — in: בבת אחת בין בזה [אחר] זה ומת כולן פטורין
  9b) אחר = "another" [Hebrew] — in: דמו ודם זרעיותיו דבר [אחר] דמי אחיך שהיה דמו
Candidates:
  1. אָחַר (from the word) — to be behind, v. Pi; euphem.) to cover (of camels); Pi. to tarry, hesitate; to set behind; Pu. to be postponed, be done late, be placed later
  2. אֲחַר (from the word) — to be behind; *to cover; Pa. take ye a later meal (on Sabbaths); Af. same; *Ithpe. contr. אִתְחַר to be delayed
  3. אַחַר (from the word) — v. foreg.), pl. constr. אַחֲרֵי after, behind; conj. followed by ש־ or ד־) after, since, whereas, because; a legal term, meaḥar, the presumption of the truth of one’s statement, because he might have pleaded more prof
  4. אַחֵר (from the word) — v. foreg. a. [back of,] another, the other, stranger. דבר א׳ (abbr. ד"א); another thing, another explanation; euphem. for idolatry, swine &c., v. דָּבָר; Aḥer, [apostate,] byname of Elisha ben Abuyah
  5. Klein: אַחֵר (from the word) — another, other; next; strange
  6. Klein: אחר (from the word) — to be or remain behind; — Qal he was late, tarried (a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring; — Pi. he delayed, tarried; — Pi. he caused one to delay, kept back; — Pu. he was late; — Hith. he came late; — Hiph. he delayed, postponed; — Hoph. was delayed, postponed
  7. Klein: אַחַר (from the word) — after, behind, afterward; behind, after

[10] suggested form אחרון
Uses:
  10a) האחרון = "the last" [Hebrew] — in: אחד וישב עליו ושברו [האחרון] חייב ואמר רב פפא
Candidates:
  1. אַחֲרוֹן (from the word) — אַחֲרוֹנָה f. (אַחֲרוֹנִית f. noun) other, next, last
  2. אָחֳרָן (from the word) — (no English given)
  3. Klein: אַחֲרוֹן (from the word) — last, latter, next; the one behind; future

[11] suggested form איבד
Uses:
  11a) המאבד = "destroys" [Hebrew] — in: אדם יחידי ללמדך שכל [המאבד] נפש אחת מישראל מעלה
  11b) איבד = "he destroyed" [Hebrew] — in: מעלה עליו הכתוב כאילו [איבד] עולם מלא וכל המקיים
Candidates:
  1. אָבַד (from the word) — v. אבב) to be pressed, go around in despair (v; to be lost, perish; to be beyond recognition. Sifré; to lose; Nif. to be lost, perish; Pi. to waste, lose, forfeit, destroy; Pi. to drop from memory, to forget. Aboth V
  2. אֲבַּד (from the word) — to be lost; Pa. to destroy; Af. = Pa; Af. to be lost, to go to ruin; Ithpa. to be lost
  3. אָבֵד (from the word) — perishable, irretrievable. דבר הא׳ a business which cannot be postponed without irretrievable loss
  4. יְבַד (from the word) — Pa. to ruin; Af. v. אֲבַד
  5. Klein: אבד (from the word) — to perish; — Qal he was lost, perished; it strayed (said of an animal); — Niph. he (or it) was lost, perished; — Pi. he destroyed, wasted; — Pi. he caused to perish; — Pi. he lost; — Hith. he committed suicide; — Hiph. he caused to perish, destroyed
  6. Klein: אָבֵד (from the word) — perishable

[12] suggested form אימה
Uses:
  12a) אימתו = "his awe" [Hebrew] — in: תשים עליך מלך שתהא [אימתו] עליך פרשת דרכים הואי
Candidates:
  1. אִימָּה I — mother, v. אִימָּא II
  2. אֵימָא (via אִימָּה I) — v. אֲמָא
  3. אימָּא I (via אִימָּה I) — distaff, v. אִימָּה II
  4. אִימָּא II (via אִימָּה I) — = h. אֵם); mother, frequ. my mother; v. אַבָּא; trnsf. the flesh of a stone fruit
  5. אִימָּא III (via אִימָּה I) — or title; cmp. אַבָּא]. Imma
  6. אִימָּה II — אמם, √אם to gather; cmp. אוּמָּה a. עמם I in Ges. H. Dict.) distaff
  7. אֵימָה — fear, awe
  8. Klein: אֵימָה — fright, terror, panic

[13] suggested form אימתי
Uses:
  13a) אימתי = "when" [Hebrew] — in: לכסות אמר רבי יהודה [אימתי] בזמן שאין שם דם
Candidates:
  1. אֵימָת (from the word) — when?
  2. אֵימָתַי (from the word) — v. אֵימָת, אֵימַת
  3. Klein: אֵימַת (from the word) — when?
  4. Klein: אֵימָתַי (from the word) — see אֵימַת
  5. Klein: אֲמִתִּי (from the word) — true, real, genuine, authentic; sincere
  6. אֵימַת (via אֵימָתַי) — whenever, when; also (אִימַתִּי) אֵימָתַי when?

[14] suggested form אין
Uses:
  14a) אינו = "is it not" [Hebrew] — in: אתה אומר לניזק או [אינו] אלא למזיק אמרת לא
